Summoning Mastery
Instant
Teaches you how to raise Flesh Golems and Gurgling Horrors.
Raise: Abomination
Raise an Abomination to aid you in combat, occupying 3 Life Force.

It is surrounded by a disease cloud, dealing 9+3.0 Points Per Level+SP*0.25 Nature damage to enemies when they deal damage and reducing their attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.

Command: Instantly unleashes an empowered disease cloud around it.

Raise: Ghoul
Raise a Ghoul to aid you in combat occupying 1 Life Force.

Its auto attacks restore 5+1.4 Points Per Level+((Int*0.504)+(SP*0.504))*0.07 health to you.

Command: Expels leeching plague that strikes up to 5 nearby enemies, dealing ((Int*0.28+SP*0.28)*0.2+(Int*0.504+SP*0.504)*0.2)+30 Plague damage, and healing you for 15+1.5 Points Per Level+SP*0.22+Int*.50 for each Ghoul.
